intro: Goodbye 700 Friday! $SPY waved farewell to 700 and our guy handled it like a legend: a heroic offer to save the market with puts, a canceled Thanksgiving, unsold tulip bulbs, a demotion to paper trading, and a fresh round of trash talk with @lordwilmehr. Then he closed the week by updating the firmware on his Christmas lights. Priorities!

items.caption: Top post of the day! A true hero stepping up: he's got the power to stop the whole selloff single-handedly, and the price is just one little order of puts. The market owes him one.
items.quote: $SPY I could single handedly stop all of this by just buying puts.

items.caption: Three words, two tickers, zero turkey. When $SPY and $TSLA both go red the week before the holiday, the feast gets called off. Dramatic? Yes. Relatable? Also yes.
A heartfelt farewell to a dear friend. He gave 700 the send-off it deserved, short and sweet.
Classic-books brain meets market panic! Nobody wants his tulip bulbs today, and that's the most historically literate sell-off joke on the board.
items.quote: $SPY No one wants to buy my Tulip bulbs

items.caption: The market-moving news of the evening: a firmware update on his Christmas lights. He posted it on X too, because the people deserve to know.
items.quote: $SPY I had to update the firmware on my CHristmas lights, how will market react?!?!

items.caption: Report card day! Our guy announced he's flunked out of real trading and is headed back to paper trading next term. Summer school legend in the making.
items.quote: $SPY $TSLA Frens I have flunked out of real trading and will be sent back to paper trading next term.

items.caption: Market commentary with a side of roast: he said the whole tape looked like a @lordwilmehr penny stock scam Discord today. Two birds, one $SPY post.
items.quote: The whole market looks like a @lordwilmehr penny stock scam discord group today. $SPY

items.caption: @lordwilmehr fired back with a "this is what happened to you" clip, and our guy swatted it away instantly. The rivalry never sleeps!
items.quote: @lordwilmehr Get that AI boomerslop outta my face!
